name: availability-service
title: The Serve service health check is failing
description: The external service health check reported the service as unhealthy for five minutes.
investigation_steps: Check whether the service health-check endpoint responds. Can you connect to it in browser or using curl?
Check the Serve ECS service, and application logs. Could the issue be related to recent deployments? If the Containers are healthy, could it be a network or connectivity issue?
If production users cannot use the service, raise an incident immediately and escalate.
